description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by graph-0017. produces[], consumes[] and task_state are emitted as asc:produces, asc:consumes and asc:taskState; every xsd:string property takes the plain form: no ^^xsd:string in Turtle, explicit in N-Quads (AGSC-05-31 form c), never form b.
note: added 2026-09-16 at rc.3 (pre-DS-4 audit); unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.3 tag
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.6 (PUB-6 Q55b; D100). Its `turtle_lines` are clause fragments carrying a trailing ` ;` and an indent, so they can only be compared as clauses inside a file the vector never states — an accepted reading, not a literal match, while AGSC-05-10 as amended at rc.5 fixes every byte of `graph.ttl`. The ports-and-task-state case it proves is preserved in graph-0017 as a whole-file `turtle` expectation.
